name: Levocetirizine

examples.title: Prevention of Asthma With Levocetirizine (36 Month Treatment) in Young Children Suffering From Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) and Sensitized to…
examples.why: The predecessor study A00309 (NCT00152464) did not show statistical significance in time to onset of asthma between the levocetirizine and placebo groups.

examples.title: The Effect of Levocetirizine on Inflammatory Mediators in Dermatographism
examples.why: Mediators of interest were not consistently detectable with the analytical methods employed.

summary: Official warnings state you should not use Levocetirizine if you have kidney disease, have had an allergic reaction to it, any of its ingredients, or an allergy medicine with cetirizine [3]. You must ask a doctor before use if you have ever had trouble urinating or emptying your bladder, and you should be aware that sleepiness can happen and alcoholic drinks should be avoided [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a low risk score of 20 for the liver and a medium risk score of 64 for the heart [M].
